markdown: After eight years and several new layers of paint, Berlin-based artist **Brad Downey** and curator **Andrian Nabi** recently revealed an original **Banksy** mural! ![banksy revealation]() The wall was painted during the [Bach Jumps festival](https://example.org/bach-jumps) in 2003 & then covered. {{< youtube abc123 >}} ## More - Photos by the artists
title: Banksy Revealed!
